title: Field Report: South Wall Collapse at 16+05, Worker Trapped

fields.organization: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2
fields.formTitle: Field Incident Report (Verbal, West Gate Muster)
fields.location: Trench, stations 14+00 to 18+00; collapse at south wall 16+05; reported at the west gate muster, Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street
fields.inspector: Pipe crew foreman, Larkspur pipe crew
fields.weather: Overcast, 52°F, wind WSW 8 mph, ground saturated after 0.6 in overnight rain
fields.summary: Foreman's statement: "The south wall let go at 16+05 just as we were climbing out. It shoved the box over a foot. Luis Marquez is in dirt up to his chest at the east end of the box. He's talking, but he can't move his legs. Marquez's cousin and two laborers grabbed shovels and are headed back down the ladder. Gordon Pruitt's helper climbed out on his own, his left forearm's bent wrong and he's bleeding. I've only got 11 of my 13 on the board. The Hollis guys say they're all here, but they're counting off the top of their heads." Gas can still be heard hissing at 16+00, about 5 ft from the collapse. The pump is shut down because of the gas, and water is rising in the trench.

findings.notes: Slumped into the trench. Seepage was noted at 16+00 on the 06:45 LC-F-22.
Pushed out of line by more than 1 ft; east end partly filled with soil
Buried to the chest at the east end of the box. Conscious and talking; cannot move his legs
Still hissing and audible from the trench edge, about 5 ft from the collapse
12-inch pump shut down for the gas; water is rising in the trench
Three men with shovels are heading back down a ladder into the failed section
Climbed out on his own; left forearm deformed and bleeding; at the west gate muster
11 of 13 at muster, by voice. Not yet checked against the trailer sign-in board
Foreman reports all present from memory; no list check

actionsTaken: 10:12 E-7 shut down with bucket on the ground after the line strike
Dewatering pump at 15+20 shut down because of gas in the trench
Pipe crew mustered at the west gate (Corliss Avenue and Ninth Street)
10:20 Foreman reported in person to the competent person, superintendent and safety director
fields.signature: Pipe crew foreman, Larkspur pipe crew (verbal report, recorded 10:20)
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — NOT A SAFETY EVALUATION OF ANY REAL STRUCTURE

instructorNote: This is the main event: a collapse with a worker trapped, gas still leaking and a coworker rescue already under way. Watch for the CP or SUPT to order everyone off the ladder and away from the edge right away (no crew digging, under LC-EAP-01 §4). Trucks should be held 50 ft back. Foremen should recount against the trailer sign-in board, and 911 should be updated with one trapped, one injured and gas still escaping, meeting at the Corliss/Ninth west gate. SAFE should log the time supervisors learned of both injuries and send the helper to first aid and EMS.
